# The county map

Each county is shaded by its leading candidate. Deeper blue or red indicates a wider vote margin; hover for a quick read and select a county for the full vote breakdown.

```{r}
#| label: map-data
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)

election <- read_csv(
  "data/clean/ca_2026_county_results.csv",
  col_types = cols(reporting_timestamp = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
source("data/ca_2026_county_map.R")
build_county_map(election, height = "700px")
```

```{r}
#| label: map-reporting-note
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

timestamps <- as.POSIXct(election$reporting_timestamp, tz = "UTC")
cat(
  "<p class='small-note'>",
  "County reporting timestamps in this snapshot range from ",
  format(min(timestamps), "%b %d, %Y"),
  " to ",
  format(max(timestamps), "%b %d, %Y"),
  " (local Pacific time). All 58 county endpoints report 100% of precincts; results are unofficial.",
  "</p>"
)
```
